records.original: A value names what matters. A standard describes behavior you can return to. “Be more reliable” leaves the action unclear. “When a deadline is at risk, I send an honest update before it passes” gives you a line you can recognize.
records.proposed: A value names what matters. A standard makes it visible in behavior. “Be more reliable” leaves the action unclear. “Before I agree to a household task, I check what I can realistically do and say so” gives you something to practice.

proposed.heading: One behavior. The whole Code.
paragraphs: The value you choose gives this card a focus. Ownership keeps the response yours. Purpose gives it a reason. Resilience helps you adapt when circumstances change. Integrity keeps the standard honest. Discipline brings you back to the behavior. Empowerment asks how what you build can help someone else without taking over their choices.
You do not need six separate actions in every situation. Keep all six values in view as you decide what this one behavior asks of you.

records.proposed: Suppose a health setback leaves you unable to manage your usual household tasks. Keeping the home workable may now mean asking for help and leaving nonessential work undone. When you can reassess, choose a method that fits your capacity. Protecting stability does not require pretending nothing changed.
records.location: In L05 Rest and support can carry responsibility, between the current third and fourth paragraphs. Mirror through existing static rendering.
records.preserve: All current L05 paragraphs and the five Alex pressure states.
records.rationale: Show adaptation to genuine capacity in ordinary life, without a medical regimen or a requirement to earn rest.

records.proposed: If you damage something you borrowed, saying sorry while returning it without mentioning the damage leaves the other person with the consequence. Tell them what happened and discuss a repair you can actually provide. They decide whether the proposed repair is acceptable.
records.location: In L04 A correction has to reach the damage, between current first paragraph and volunteer example. Mirror through existing static rendering.
records.preserve: Every original paragraph and the complete Riley/Maya annotated record.
records.rationale: Make correction materially tangible: accurate disclosure and agreed repair, beyond writing a better message.

records.original: Consider someone who has repeatedly avoided difficult work conversations. One honest conversation matters. Returning to honesty in later conversations begins to establish a different pattern. They do not have to wait until they feel like a completely different person before speaking truthfully. The action can come first. Over time, a changed pattern can support a changed understanding of who they are.
records.proposed: Consider someone rebuilding a dependable morning. When time and capacity allow, they put the things they need by the door before settling down for the evening. One prepared morning helps. Returning to that small action on later evenings begins a pattern. If their needs or capacity change, the arrangement can change too. The evidence is in the preparation they keep doing, not the routine they describe.
records.location: Replace only the short work-conversation illustration in Repetition builds evidence. Mirror through existing static rendering.
records.preserve: Other paragraphs in that section; Noor/Eli seven occasions and three patterns; work-handover transfer prompt.
records.rationale: Teach repeated private preparation in a personal routine instead of another work conversation.

records.original: An experienced colleague can explain the agenda tool and leave room for a new meeting leader to use it. Taking over the topics, decisions and final message may finish the agenda while taking the leadership away. Getting the task done and helping someone become more capable are not the same achievement.
records.proposed: A friend wants to learn how to mend a loose button. Show the step, leave room for them to try and give the help they need. If they need you to hold the fabric while they work, that assistance can remain. Taking the garment away and finishing it may solve the immediate task. It does not, by itself, give them the practice they wanted.
records.location: Replace only the short agenda-tool illustration in Put strength to use without placing yourself above people. Mirror in static and complete print reading.
records.preserve: All other lesson copy, necessary-care protections, Mara/Dev/Jordan facts and all three recipient replies.
records.rationale: Distinguish teaching capability from taking over through a practical friendship example, with ongoing assistance respected.
